slides.h: The field map doubled its honesty, not its size
b: 28 papers, coverage unknown → 40 papers, 9 branches, tested by 3 methods, blind spots written on it.

slides.h: Each method found what the last one could not
b: A recorded 45-query harvest found 52 candidates. Training-memory recall found 4 more that no query hit — one DOI remembered digit-for-digit.
Two whole branches were missing: shock-wave interiors, and the white-hole big bang.
The Rothman–Ellis critique is probably real — and unverifiable through every route we have. Probably is not the bar. It waits in the appendix.

slides.h: 30 percent of the base layer is now unread
b: Eleven entries went in classed unread, because nobody here has opened them.
The outstanding work is no longer finding papers. It is reading them.
